title: 八角形スタジオソフトボックス
description: 公共スタジオ・ポートレート撮影室向けの拡散照明外装。八枚の厚み付き布パネル、無地の前面拡散布、縁の綴じと放射状継ぎ目、後部灯体・グリル、傾斜ヨーク、伸縮式外形の三脚支柱と固定電源線を造形。追尾スポットとは異なる広い拡散面の機材です。布とレンズ類は不透明PBRで発光せず、照明・通電・調整動作やスタンド安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.044 × 2.373 × 1.019 m、9,848三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A diffused-lighting exterior for public studios and portrait rooms. It has eight thick fabric wall panels, plain front diffusion cloth, bound perimeter and radial seams, rear lamp housing/grille, tilt yoke, telescoping-style tripod stand and fixed power cable. Its broad diffuser is distinct from a followspot. Cloth and optical surfaces use opaque non-emissive PBR materials; lighting, electrical operation, adjustment and stand safety are not validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.044 × 2.373 × 1.019 m; 9,848 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
